# docker_logs (Data Source)

Reads a container's logs (`GET /containers/{id}/logs`) as a list of lines. Output of containers without a TTY is demultiplexed, so lines carry no stream headers; stdout and stderr are interleaved in the order the daemon returns them. The read does not follow the log, and keeps at most 16 MiB.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_logs" "web" {
  container  = "web"
  tail       = "100"
  since      = "15m"
  timestamps = true
}

output "web_errors" {
  value = [for l in data.docker_logs.web.logs_list_string : l if strcontains(l, "ERROR")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) Container name or ID.

### Optional

- `details` (Boolean) Add the extra attributes the log driver records (for example labels) to each line. Default `false`.
- `show_stderr` (Boolean) Include standard error. Default `true`.
- `show_stdout` (Boolean) Include standard output. Default `true`.
- `since` (String) Only lines after this time: RFC 3339 timestamp, Unix timestamp, or a duration relative to now such as `10m`.
- `tail` (String) Number of lines to read from the end of the log, or `all`. Default `all`.
- `timestamps` (Boolean) Prefix every line with its RFC 3339 timestamp. Default `false`.
- `until` (String) Only lines before this time, same formats as `since`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Container ID.
- `logs_list_string` (List of String) Log lines without their trailing newline.
